topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing by welcoming students, recapping the histology practicals, and introducing the lecture's learning objectives.

topics.label: Viral Origins and Experimental Assays of Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and how transformation is experimentally tested in laboratory assays.

topics.label: Classifications and Genetic Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the definitions, cell-cycle pathways, and genetic modes of action that distinguish oncogenic and tumor-suppressive mutations.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in DNA repair pathways, replication fidelity, and mitotic chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multistep Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the sequential acquisition of mutations drives tumor evolution and how inheriting germline mutations accelerates cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic contains the closing framing by concluding the presentation, offering recommended reading, and outlining the next lecture.
